tool_args.rationale: All five pilot horizons are at or below 0.48, while confirmation targets H=20.3. A long-horizon measurement can test whether slow adaptation reverses the positive pilot response and constrain its magnitude before fitting the sink-coupled law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-window data primarily constrain the ratio of slow adaptation amplitude to its time constant, not their separate effects at H=20.3.
Finer temporal sampling could refine the fast response but is less direct for resolving long-horizon adaptation.
It does not address the uncertainty in the slow response.
